master.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: full-body seated character-only master for 100next traditional sprite animation.
Input image 1: approved cast concept. June is the THIRD character, the woman in teal. Use ONLY June's exact character design and face as identity reference.
Input image 2: Finn's accepted padded full-body rest sets the forward camera, cartoon outline/shading style and seated anchor. Do not copy Finn's identity.
Primary request: Draw ONE June, fully head to shoes, sitting front-facing as if on the exact burgundy gold chair from the cast, but omit the entire chair. True transparent background. Keep June's warm brown complexion, short full curly black hair, gold hoop earrings, white rolled sleeves, tailored dark teal vest and trousers, black necktie and black-and-white Oxford shoes. Controlled, knowing neutral expression, slight skeptical brow. Maintain an adult cartoon woman, not a child.
Composition: body and torso face the table directly; preserve her seated crossed-leg arrangement from the concept, both shoes fully visible. Hold two small black-and-gold card BACKS in a fan at chest height, in the hand on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE; empty RIGHT-side hand rests next to the fan. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs. Cards contain a simple small gold 100. One complete connected character drawing; no separated limbs or head, no puppet parts.
Style: polished adult TV cartoon, bold clean dark outlines, flat colors with restrained cel shading, consistent with Finn but June's exact approved face/clothing. No textured painting.
Framing: square transparent canvas, center the whole seated figure, generous blank margin above curls, below shoes and both sides. No background, no chair, no table, no titles or labels. Do not crop hair, shoes, shoulders or hands.
